name: protonet_cluster
description: Few-shot ProtoNet on cluster-aggregated CONCH tumor-tile embeddings (FM-MSI benchmark recipe). WSI embeddings = concatenated per-group means of a global k-means over tumor-only CONCH tiles; ProtoNet prototypes are per-class training means, scored by softmax over negative squared distance. Reports a few-shot curve K∈{1,2,4,8,16,all}. Frozen features only.
